data.one_liner: Implicitly animates text changes with smooth transitions
data.what_it_does: Anitex provides a widget that automatically animates when the displayed text changes. It handles opacity and token-based animations for a polished effect.
use_when: You want animated text without custom animation code
You need a quick, drop‑in solution for text transitions
You target Flutter 3+ and want null‑safe implementation
avoid_when: You need complex animation control or custom easing curves
Your text changes frequently with large length differences causing performance issues
weaknesses: Limited to text only, no layout or style customization beyond TextStyle
Animation behavior may not suit all use cases
No support for complex token animations beyond opacity
data.minimal_example:
```dart
AnimatedText(
  "Hello World",
  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headline6,
  duration: const Duration(seconds: 1),
)
```
